settings.heading: Made for the way your knees actually feel by the evening.

settings.question: Will it fit me?
settings.answer: The adjustable strap is designed to fit most leg sizes comfortably — snugger or looser, depending on what feels right for you.

settings.question: Is it safe to use every day?
settings.answer: Yes — it's designed for regular use. As with any heat product, follow the included guide, and check with your GP first if you have a health condition.

settings.question: Will this replace my doctor's treatment?
settings.answer: No. It's designed for warmth, gentle compression and comfort — not to treat, prevent or cure any condition. For ongoing joint pain, please speak to your GP.

settings.heading: Straight answers to the questions people actually have.

settings.title: Steady, adjustable heat
settings.text: Three settings warm the wrap gently and evenly, without ever feeling like too much.

settings.title: Gentle air pressure
settings.text: A built-in air chamber inflates and releases in a soft rhythm, for a supportive squeeze.

settings.title: Light vibration
settings.text: A quiet, low-intensity vibration adds a further layer of comfort while you relax.

settings.heading: One for you — or share the comfort.
settings.subheading: Many customers buy a second for the other knee, or as a gift for a parent or partner.

settings.question: What does the knee massager actually do?
settings.answer: It combines gentle warmth, adjustable air compression and light vibration for comfort after activity or at the end of a long day. It's not a medical device and doesn't treat any condition.

settings.question: How long does the battery last?
settings.answer: A full charge gives you several sessions before it needs topping up — full spec details are in the box guide. It charges via USB, so it's easy to top up anywhere.

settings.question: What leg sizes does it fit?
settings.answer: The adjustable strap is designed to fit most adult leg sizes comfortably. If you're unsure, our team can help you check before you order.

settings.question: How do I clean it?
settings.answer: Wipe the outer fabric with a damp cloth. Do not submerge the unit in water — full care instructions are included in the box.

settings.question: What's your returns policy?
settings.answer: If it's not right for you, send it back within 30 days of delivery for a full refund.

settings.question: How fast is delivery?
settings.answer: Standard UK delivery takes 3–5 working days and is tracked door to door. Delivery is free on orders over £40.
